prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording like this, so just call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a two-lane road in Pearland, Texas, near a shopping center. I was heading home from work.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was driving at maybe twenty-five miles an hour, going around a slight curve. The other car came over into my lane.

Q: Did you have time to brake or steer?

A: I braked hard and turned a little to the right, but it wasn't enough. We hit nose to nose, though it wasn't a big impact. Both cars were still drivable at first.

Q: Did you feel any injury right after the collision?

A: Not right away. I felt okay for maybe an hour. Then my neck got stiff and I started getting headaches.

Q: Have you seen a doctor?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that evening and then saw my regular doctor later in the week. They said I have whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some physical therapy.

Q: Are you still having symptoms?

A: Yes. Turning my head to the left hurts, and I get a dull ache across my shoulders by the end of the day. Sitting at my desk for long stretches makes it worse.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I missed a few days and I've been working reduced hours since then. I'm still getting used to it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the rules of the road and I didn't cross the center line on purpose. I'm just trying to get better.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
